new_claims.statement: Under retained witness noise comparison, m noised ideal multipliers leak at most one quotient factor times P_guess(S|S+G), plus noise error. Actual two-point source may support m=2.
Structured partial splitting x^f-a may reduce conditional quotient extraction to f split-ring blocks of dimension N=n/f.
Two-source ideal-linear transformations may preserve common-zero deficiency of order d/q²; finite law being tested.
